network: Uses WebTorrent to contact trackers and peers or a metadata source in the link.
invalid: Enter a magnet link containing a valid BitTorrent v1 info hash (btih).
unavailable: Metadata could not be retrieved. Try again or open the .torrent file if you have it.
timeout: No metadata arrived in time. The torrent may have no reachable WebTorrent peers or metadata source.
related: Have a .torrent file? Open Torrent File Viewer
